# Write Urdu

> Write Urdu is an independently maintained browser-based Urdu writing platform for Roman Urdu transliteration, direct Urdu typing, document formatting and practical creative tools. No account or installation is required for the core writing experience.

Canonical site: https://www.write-urdu.com/

Important facts:

- The homepage is the main English to Urdu typing and Urdu typing online surface: type Roman Urdu with English letters and convert it into Urdu script.
- Roman Urdu conversion is transliteration, not translation. Writers should review ambiguous names, spellings and important text before sharing it.
- The Urdu Keyboard supports direct Urdu-character input when exact spelling or punctuation matters.
- The Rich Text Editor is intended for formatted Urdu documents, headings, lists, fonts, alignment and export.
- Urdu Card Studio is the primary image-creation surface for putting Urdu text, poetry, quotes and announcements on a background or photo and exporting the finished design.
- Local drafts and several creation workflows use browser storage or browser-side processing. Roman Urdu suggestions may use the transliteration provider described in the privacy policy.
- Write Urdu does not require an account for the core editors.
- Product guides are maintained against the current public interface. Corrections can be reported through the public feedback channel.
- Last reviewed: 2026-08-12.

## Start writing

- [English to Urdu typing / Urdu typing online](https://www.write-urdu.com/): Type Roman Urdu with English letters, press Space to convert words into Urdu script, review suggestions, copy text and continue into other writing tools. This is transliteration, not English-language translation.
- [Urdu Rich Text Editor](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-editor): Format Urdu with headings, fonts, colours, lists and alignment, then export a document.
- [Online Urdu Keyboard](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-keyboard): Type Urdu characters directly with an on-screen or physical keyboard.

## Learn Urdu writing

- [Roman Urdu transliteration guide](https://www.write-urdu.com/roman-urdu-transliteration): Explains how Roman Urdu becomes Urdu script, why spellings can be ambiguous and why transliteration is not translation.
- [Urdu alphabet guide](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-alphabet): Common standalone Urdu characters, names, right-to-left direction and joining behavior.
- [Complete Write Urdu documentation](https://www.write-urdu.com/write-urdu-documentation): Editor modes, transliteration, direct input, formatting, drafts, exports and related creation tools.
- [Write Urdu FAQ](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-faq): Product, privacy, export, transliteration and Urdu-script questions.
- [Urdu fonts: Nastaliq vs Naskh](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-fonts-nastaliq-vs-naskh): Practical comparison of Urdu font styles for documents, interfaces and designs.
- [How to write Urdu on a photo](https://www.write-urdu.com/how-to-write-urdu-on-photo): Practical steps for adding Urdu text, poetry or quotes to a local photo, choosing readable Urdu fonts and exporting the image in Card Studio.
- [Roman Urdu typing tutorial](https://www.write-urdu.com/english-urdu-typing-tutorial): Step-by-step typing, suggestion and formatting guidance.

## Create and export

- [Urdu Card Studio](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-card-studio): Write Urdu text or poetry on a photo, create quote/post/announcement images with Urdu fonts and templates, and export the finished PNG.
- [Urdu Template Library](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-templates): Browse starter designs and open a selected template in Card Studio.
- [Urdu and English Invoice Generator](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-invoice-generator): Create Urdu, English or bilingual invoices with automatic totals and local export.
- [Static QR Code Generator](https://www.write-urdu.com/qr-code-generator): Create static QR codes for Urdu text, links, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp and contacts.

## Trust, policies and corrections

- [About Write Urdu](https://www.write-urdu.com/why-write-urdu): Product purpose, who the project helps, known limitations, maintenance approach and editorial/correction policy.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.write-urdu.com/write-urdu-privacy): Local storage, uploaded images, transliteration, analytics, ads, QR content and feedback handling.
- [Feedback and corrections](https://www.write-urdu.com/write-urdu-feedback): Public channel for transliteration issues, outdated guidance, accessibility problems and browser bugs.
- [Security contact](https://www.write-urdu.com/.well-known/security.txt): Standard security-reporting contact and canonical policy file.
- [Human-readable sitemap](https://www.write-urdu.com/write-urdu-sitemap): Index of public editors, tools, guides and policy pages.

## Optional

- [Stylish Urdu Text Generator](https://www.write-urdu.com/stylish-urdu-text-generator): Copyable Unicode Urdu styles and a handoff into name-art creation.
- [Urdu Name Art Maker](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-name-art-maker): Create Urdu name images with font-based designs.
- [Urdu WhatsApp Status Maker](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-whatsapp-status-maker): Create downloadable Urdu status images.
- [Urdu Instagram Post Maker](https://www.write-urdu.com/urdu-instagram-post-maker): Create Urdu social images in common Instagram dimensions.
